items.title: George Holani: Solid with double-digit touches
items.body_text: Holani rushed 12 times for 42 yards in the Seahawks' 17-7 preseason loss to the Cowboys on Saturday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Isaiah Likely: Two grabs in preseason loss
items.body_text: Likely caught both his targets for 11 yards in Saturday's 13-10 preseason loss to the Vikings. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyrone Tracy: Just two touches in preseason opener
items.body_text: Tracy carried the ball twice for five yards in Saturday's 13-10 preseason loss to the Vikings. He failed to catch his only target. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaxson Dart: Plays two series in preseason opener
items.body_text: Dart completed three of four passes for 26 yards and a touchdown in Saturday's 13-10 preseason loss to the Vikings. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Good to go in preseason opener
items.body_text: Addison (thumb) caught his only target for eight yards in Saturday's 13-10 preseason win over the Giants. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
